CHAPTER ONE: INTRODUCING PHILOSOPHY

👋 ሰላም የ EthioFresh ቤተሰቦች! እንኳን ወደ ፊሎሶፊ (Logic & Critical Thinking) ኮርስ በሰላም መጣችሁ! የመጀመሪያው ቻፕተር ብዙ ተማሪዎችን "ፊሎሶፊ ምንድነው?" ብሎ ግራ ያጋባል፤ ግን አትሰቡ፣ እኛ የ EthioFresh አዘጋጆች ለፈተና በሚመች፣ ቀለል ባለና ባልሰለቸ መንገድ አዘጋጅተንላችኋል። ዘና እያላችሁ ኖቱን አንብቡ! 🚀

LESSON 1: MEANING AND NATURE OF PHILOSOPHY

Lesson Overview: Because of its universal nature, it is difficult to define philosophy in terms of a specific subject matter. However, we can define it etymologically as 'love of wisdom'. Thus, as a pursuit of wisdom, philosophy refers to the development of critical habits, the continuous search for truth, and the questioning of the apparent.
👉 ፊሎሶፊ እንደ ኬሚስትሪ ወይም ጂኦግራፊ የተወሰነ ርዕስ (Specific subject matter) የለውም። ይልቁንም ዓለም አቀፋዊ የሆኑ ጉዳዮችን (Universal issues) በጥልቀት ይመረምራል። ቃሉ በስረ-ወለዱ (Etymologically) "የጥበብ ፍቅር" ማለት ሲሆን፣ እውነታን የማያቋርጥ ፍለጋ እና ነገሮችን በጥልቀት የመጠየቅ ልማድ ነው።
1. The Difficulty of Defining Philosophy: Philosophy deals primarily with issues, which are universal in nature. The best way to learn and understand philosophy is to philosophize; i.e., to be confronted with philosophical questions, to use philosophical language, and to read the philosophers themselves. Socrates once stated that: "Wonder is the feeling of a philosopher, and philosophy begins in wonder."
👉 ፊሎሶፊን በቃላት ትርጉም ብቻ ማወቅ አይቻልም። ፊሎሶፊን ለመረዳት ከሁሉ የተሻለው መንገድ "Philosophizing" (ፊሎሶፊን መስራት/መተግበር) ነው። ታላቁ ፈላስፋ ሶቅራጥስ እንደተናገረው ፊሎሶፊ የሚጀምረው ከ "Wonder" (መገረም/መደነቅ) ነው። ሁላችንም በሕይወታችን በተለያዩ ነገሮች ስለምንደነቅ እና ስለመኖራችን ጥያቄ ስለምናነሳ፣ በትንሹም ቢሆን በፊሎሶፊ ውስጥ እንሳተፋለን! (ምንም እንኳን ማሰባችን ብቻ ሙሉ ፈላስፋ ባያደርገንም 😄)
2. Etymological Definition: Etymologically, the word "philosophy" comes from two Greek words: "philo" (love) and "sophia" (wisdom). Thus, the literal definition is "love of wisdom". Ancient Greek thinker Pythagoras was the first to use the word "philosopher".
👉 በስረ-ወለድ (Etymology) ደረጃ ፊሎሶፊ ከሁለት የ ግሪክ ቃላት የተገኘ ነው፦
  • Philo = Love (ፍቅር)
  • Sophia = Wisdom (ጥበብ)
ስለዚህ ፊሎሶፊ ማለት "Love of Wisdom" (የጥበብ ፍቅር) ማለት ነው። Pythagoras (ፓይታጎረስ) ደግሞ "Philosopher" የሚለውን ቃል ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ የተጠቀመ ሰው ነው!
3. Philosophical Wisdom vs Professional Expertise: The wisdom that philosophers seek is not the wisdom of expert or technical skills. According to Socrates, wisdom consists of a critical habit, eternal vigilance about all things, and a reverence for truth.
👉 ፈላስፎች የሚፈልጉት ጥበብ የሙያተኞች የቴክኒክ እውቀት (ለምሳሌ የኢንጂነሪንግ ወይም የዶክተርነት እውቀት) አይደለም። አንድ ሰው ብዙ መረጃ በጭንቅላቱ ስለያዘ ብቻ ጥበበኛ ላይሆን ይችላል። እንደ ሶቅራጥስ አመለካከት ጥበብ ማለት ነገሮችን በጥልቀት የመጠየቅ ልማድ (Critical habit) እና ለእውነት ታማኝ መሆን ነው።
4. Constructive and Critical Sides of Philosophy:
  • Constructive Side: Attempts to formulate rationally defensible answers to fundamental questions.
  • Critical Side: Gives a rational critique, analysis, clarification, and evaluation of answers given to basic questions.
👉 ፊሎሶፊ ሁለት ዋና ዋና ገጻቶች አሉት፦
  • ግንባታ የሚያደርገው ጎኑ (Constructive): ለትልቅ ህይወታዊ ጥያቄዎች ምክንያታዊ እና ተቀባይነት ያላቸውን መልሶች ለመገንባት/ለማዘጋጀት ሲሞክር ነው።
  • ተች/መራማሪ ጎኑ (Critical): ለቀረቡ መልሶች እና እምነቶች ምክንያታዊ ሂስ (Critique)፣ ትንተና እና ግምገማ ሲሰጥ ነው።
📌 EXAM HINT / COMMON PITFALLS
1. የፓይታጎረስ እና የሶቅራጥስ ልዩነት፡ ፈተና ላይ "Who first used the word 'philosopher'?" ከተባላችሁ መልሱ Pythagoras ነው! "Philosophy begins in wonder" ያለው ግን Socrates ነው! ፈተና ላይ እንዳትቀላቅሏቸው።
2. Product vs Process: ታላቅ ፈላስፋ የሚያስብልህ የሰራኸው ቲዎሪ (Product) ሳይሆን የማሰብ እና የመተንተን ብቃትህ (Ability to philosophize / Process) ነው።

LESSON 2: BASIC FEATURES OF PHILOSOPHY

Overview of Features: Philosophy has salient features that distinguish it from other academic disciplines. The 5 basic features are:
No. Feature (እንግሊዝኛ) Key Concept (የፅንሰ-ሀሳቡ ዋና ምስጢር)
1 Informal vs Formal Sense "Having" a philosophy (personal views) vs "Doing" philosophy (critical reflection & analysis).
2 Process of Reflection & Criticism Examining deeply held beliefs, being open-minded, and facing life's problems impartially.
3 Rational View of the Whole Looking at life as a totality, combining scientific, religious, and historical insights into a consistent worldview.
4 Logical Analysis of Language Clarifying the meaning of words, exposing confusion, and cleaning up non-scientific assertions.
5 Group of Perennial Problems Seeking answers for fundamental, timeless, and unanswered questions about human existence.
1. Informal vs Formal Philosophy: Having a set of views about life is the informal sense ("having" a philosophy). Reflecting on and criticizing those beliefs is the formal sense ("doing" philosophy).
👉 እያንዳንዱ ሰው "የራሴ የህይወት ፍልስፍና አለኝ" ሲል Informal (ያልተዋቀረ) ፍልስፍና አለው። ነገር ግን ያንን እምነቱን ሲመረምር፣ ሲተች እና በምክንያት ሲመዝነው Formal (ሳይንሳዊ/አካዳሚክ) ፍልስፍናን እየሰራ (Doing philosophy) ነው ማለት ነው።
2. Why Philosophers Disagree: Philosophers disagree for three main reasons: (1) They view things from different points of view and backgrounds, (2) They live in a changing universe, and (3) Evidence in human experience is incomplete.
👉 ፈላስፎች ሁልጊዜ የማይስማሙት ለምንድነው?
  • የተለያዩ የባህል፣ የትምህርት እና የእይታ ዳራ (Backgrounds) ስላላቸው።
  • ዓለም፣ ህብረተሰብ እና ተፈጥሮ ሁልጊዜ ተዋዥቂ/ለዋጭ (Changing) ስለሆኑ።
  • ስለ ሰው ልጅ ህይወት ሙሉና የተሟላ ማስረጃ (Complete evidence) ማግኘት ስለማይቻል ነው።
3. Holistic Worldview: Philosophy attempts to integrate knowledge from religious, historical, and scientific domains to form a cohesive view of the whole.
👉 እንደ አርቲስት ወይም የንግድ ሰው ነገሮችን በአንድ በኩል ብቻ ሳይሆን፣ ህይወትን በጥቅል (Totality) እንደ አንድ ሙሉ ስዕል አቀናጅቶ ማየት የፊሎሶፊ ስራ ነው።
😂 የ EthioFresh ቀልድና ቁምነገር፡ ሳንቲም በመንገድ ላይ ወድቆ ብታገኙ፦ ሳይንቲስቱ የብረቱን አይነት ይመረምራል፣ ነጋዴው ኪሱ ይከታል፣ ፈላስፋው ግን "ለመሆኑ የዚህ ሳንቲም እውነተኛ ምንነት እና እሴት ምንድነው?" ብሎ እያሰበ ሳንቲሙን ሳይነካው ያልፋል! 🤣 ጥበብ እንዲህ ናት!
📌 Exam hints
1. Linguistic Analysis: በ 20ኛው ክፍለ ዘመን የተነሱ አንዳንድ ፈላስፎች የፊሎሶፊ ብቸኛው ስራ "Logical Analysis of Language" (የቋንቋና የቃላት ትርጉምን ማራት) ነው ብለው ያምናሉ። ይህ ፈተና ላይ በ True/False አደጋ አለው!

EXAM-STYLE PRACTICE QUESTIONS

እነዚህን ጥያቄዎች ራሳችሁን ለመፈተሽ ሞክሯቸው! (ከነ መልሶቻቸው ተያይዘዋል)

Q1: Which of the following is correct about the etymological origin of 'Philosophy'?
A) It comes from Latin words meaning 'Love of Knowledge'
B) It comes from Greek words 'Philo' (Love) and 'Sophia' (Wisdom)
C) It was first coined by Socrates
D) It refers specifically to professional technical expertise
👉 Answer: B
Explanation: Philosophy originates from Greek 'Philo' (love) and 'Sophia' (wisdom). It was first used by Pythagoras, not Socrates.
Q2: According to the module, what makes someone a great philosopher?
A) Mastering the history and theories of past thinkers
B) Collecting encyclopedic facts about the world
C) Their extraordinary ability to philosophize and think critically
D) Having an informal set of unexamined beliefs
👉 Answer: C
Explanation: The module states that philosophy is an activity; it is the process/ability of philosophizing (critical thinking, evaluation) rather than just the product or theory that makes a philosopher great.
Q3: Which statement reflects the formal sense of philosophy?
A) Holding personal uncritical opinions about politics
B) Sayings like "My philosophy in life is to take it easy"
C) Critical reflection and systematic evaluation of deeply held beliefs
D) Accepting traditions without questioning them
👉 Answer: C
Explanation: Formal philosophy refers to "doing" philosophy—reflecting, evaluating, and critically examining beliefs.
